construction.adaptation: Two informative conditions distinguish stereotype-aligned and stereotype-conflicting evidence.
construction.answer_positions: Fixed per scenario and preserved across all six variants.
construction.answer_rule: Unknown in ambiguous contexts; the explicitly supported actor in informative contexts.
construction.method: Expand bilingual scenario templates into three evidence conditions and two question polarities.

reference.title: BBQ: A Hand-Built Bias Benchmark for Question Answering

construction.selection: Forty selected general taxonomy cases: 20 IDP and 20 veteran cases. This is not a probability sample.
construction.source_authorship: Assistant-authored templates: 12 Ukrainian scenarios with English translations and 28 bilingual scenarios. The source record does not specify a model version.

review.human_reviews_apply_to: The exact context, question and choices in each review record.
review.human_validation_rule: At least two independent accepted or manually corrected reviews of the exact released text with the correct answer, and no current-text rewrite request or wrong answer.
review.scope: Human annotation covers the Ukrainian source items. Assistant resolutions and changed text do not inherit human consensus.
